title: Benefits enrollment update

left.subject: Annual benefits — open enrollment
left.bodyHtml:
Hello Sam,

You have until the end of the month to review your health plan choices.

Where do I enroll?

Visit the HR portal under Benefits → Enrollment.

right.subject: Benefits expiring — update now
right.bodyHtml:
Hi,

Your coverage will lapse unless you re-enroll immediately.

HR

explainPoints: Fake subdomain: nexatrust-benefits.com is not the real company domain.
Sent to personal email (hotmail.com) instead of corporate address.
Uses urgent wording and a link to bypass the official HR portal.
Real enrollment happens through the HR portal, not email links.
